name: random-field Ising antiferromagnet in a uniform field
question: Does an antiferromagnet with quenched disorder return to the same configuration when a uniform field comes back to an earlier turning point?
assumptions: Elements with two states coupled antiferromagnetically to their four neighbours on a square lattice, which is bipartite: no loop of couplings is frustrated
Gaussian random local fields of width 2 in units of the coupling
A uniform field, changed slowly; thermal activation is neglected

provenance.source: model; for antiferromagnetic chains see J. M. Deutsch, A. Dhar and O. Narayan, Phys. Rev. Lett. 92, 227203 (2004)
